# clerk_organization_membership (Resource)

Manages a Clerk organization membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_organization_membership" "example" {
  organization_id = clerk_organization.example.id
  user_id         = "user_abc123"
  role            = "org:admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization.
- `role` (String) Role key to assign to the member (e.g. org:admin, org:member).
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user to add as a member.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the membership was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization membership.
- `role_name` (String) Display name of the assigned role.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the membership was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_organization_membership.example <organization_id>/<user_id>
```
